in_marathi.name: Shravani
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Abundance of Knowledge
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shravani हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Goddess of knowledge, education, and wisdom. She is believed to bring an abundance of knowledge and prosperity to those who invoke her.
